run_chrome_trace_parser: run the chrome trace parser CLI to compute GPU utilization from PyTorch profiler JSON traces
parse_gpu_events: parse GPU compute events from a PyTorch chrome trace JSON file and filter by process labels
get_mm_conv_utilization: get the matrix multiply and convolution GPU utilization from sorted GPU events in a trace
calculate_gpu_duration: calculate the total GPU duration from sorted GPU events accounting for overlapping timelines
extract_model_name: extract the model name from a chrome trace JSON filename using the underscore chrome trace convention
